name: Nina Fautrier
source:
A high-class prostitute (courtisane) who suddenly appeared in Paris during the Second French Empire. With her silky black hair and crimson dress, she has a devilish charm that drives men mad and destroys them. But in reality, Nina is a crossdressing boy prostitute who harbors anger and sorrow in his heart.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170928093605/http://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ170429.html]DLsite[/url]]
